mapper.select:
SELECT SM.SALES_NO , SM.SALES_SEQ , SM.INVOICE_MONTH , D.DIVISION_NAME , C.CUSTOMER_NAME , SM.PRODUCT_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , IM.HS_CODE , COALESCE(SM.STATUS, 0) AS STATUS , GET_CODE_NAME(COALESCE(SM.STATUS, 0)::VARCHAR, 'DS', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS STATUS_NAME , GET_CODE_NAME(SM.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE, 'AT', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE_NAME , SM.COO_CERTIFY_NO FROM (
SELECT G.COMPANY_CODE , G.INVOICE_MONTH , G.DIVISION_CODE , G.CUSTOMER_CODE , G.PRODUCT_CODE , G.STATUS , G.COO_CERTIFY_NO , G.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE , G.QUANTITY , REP.SALES_NO , REP.SALES_SEQ FROM ( SELECT SM.COMPANY_CODE , SUBSTR(SM.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) AS INVOICE_MONTH , SD.DIVISION_CODE , SM.CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , SUM(CASE WHEN SM.VIRTUAL_YN = 'Y' THEN SD.STATUS::INTEGER ELSE 0 END) AS STATUS , MAX(CASE WHEN SM.VIRTUAL_YN = 'Y' THEN SD.COO_CERTIFY_NO ELSE NULL END) AS COO_CERTIFY_NO , SD.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE , SUM(SD.QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER_MODEL CM ON CM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND CM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE AND CM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE AND CM.CUSTOMER_CODE = SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'D'
AND SM.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN #{from_date} AND #{to_date}
GROUP BY SM.COMPANY_CODE , SUBSTR(SM.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) , SM.CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE , SD.DIVISION_CODE , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , SM.EXPORT_FLAG , SD.PROD_DIVISION_CODE , COALESCE(CM.CUSTOMER_ITEM_CODE, SD.CUSTOMER_ITEM_CODE) , SD.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE ) G LEFT JOIN (
SELECT DISTINCT ON (SM4.COMPANY_CODE, SM4.CUSTOMER_CODE, SD4.DIVISION_CODE, SD4.PRODUCT_CODE, SUBSTR(SM4.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6)) SM4.COMPANY_CODE , SM4.CUSTOMER_CODE , SD4.DIVISION_CODE , SD4.PRODUCT_CODE , SUBSTR(SM4.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) AS INVOICE_MONTH , SM4.SALES_NO , SD4.SALES_SEQ FROM SALES_MST SM4 INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD4 ON SM4.COMPANY_CODE = SD4.COMPANY_CODE AND SM4.SALES_NO = SD4.SALES_NO AND SM4.DIVISION_CODE = SD4.DIVISION_CODE WHERE SM4.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM4.EXPORT_FLAG = 'D'
AND SM4.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN #{from_date} AND #{to_date}
ORDER BY SM4.COMPANY_CODE, SM4.CUSTOMER_CODE, SD4.DIVISION_CODE, SD4.PRODUCT_CODE, SUBSTR(SM4.INVOICE_DATE, 1, 6) , SM4.VIRTUAL_YN DESC, SM4.SALES_NO, SD4.SALES_SEQ ) REP ON REP.COMPANY_CODE = G.COMPANY_CODE AND REP.CUSTOMER_CODE = G.CUSTOMER_CODE AND REP.DIVISION_CODE = G.DIVISION_CODE AND REP.PRODUCT_CODE = G.PRODUCT_CODE AND REP.INVOICE_MONTH = G.INVOICE_MONTH ) SM INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SM.PRODUCT_CODE LEFT JOIN DIVISION D ON D.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND D.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SM.CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND SM.QUANTITY > 0 -- 반품 제외
AND D.DIVISION_CODE = #{division_code}
AND (C.CUSTOMER_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' OR C.CUSTOMER_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' )
AND (SM.PRODUCT_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' OR IM.ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' )
ORDER BY SM.INVOICE_MONTH, C.CUSTOMER_CODE, D.DIVISION_CODE, SM.PRODUCT_CODE, SM.SALES_NO, SM.SALES_SEQ

SELECT SM.SALES_NO , SD.SALES_SEQ , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , IM.HS_CODE , SD.QUANTITY , IM.UNIT , SD.UNIT_PRICE , SD.AMOUNT FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND (SM.SALES_NO, SD.SALES_SEQ) IN
(#{d.sales_no}, #{d.sales_seq})

SELECT FM.FTA_CODE , FM.HS_CODE , FTA.FTA_NAME , FM.AMOUNT , FM.RULE_CONTENTS , FM.COMPANY_COO_YN , FR.RVC_RATE , FR.DE_MINIMIS_RATE FROM FCR_MST FM INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FTA ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FTA.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FTA.FTA_CODE INNER JOIN FCR_RESULT FR ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FR.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FR.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FR.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FR.SALES_SEQ AND FM.RULE_CONTENTS = FR.RULE_CODE WHERE FM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FM.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FM.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq}

SELECT SM.INVOICE_DATE , D.DIVISION_NAME , C.CUSTOMER_NAME , SM.INVOICE_NO , SM.STATUS , GET_CODE_NAME(SM.STATUS, 'DS', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS STATUS_NAME , GET_CODE_NAME(COALESCE(SM.ARRIVAL_NATION, C.NATION_CODE), 'NA', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS EXPORT_NATION , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FTA_APPLY_NATION FAN WHERE FAN.NATION_CODE = COALESCE(SM.ARRIVAL_NATION, C.NATION_CODE) AND FAN.EFFECT_DATE <= SM.INVOICE_DATE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FAN.FTA_CODE) AS FTA_CNT FROM ( SELECT SM.COMPANY_CODE , SM.SALES_NO , SM.DIVISION_CODE FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'E'
AND SM.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN #{from_date} AND #{to_date}
AND (SM.PRODUCT_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' OR IM.ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' )
GROUP BY SM.COMPANY_CODE, SM.SALES_NO, SM.DIVISION_CODE ) SALES INNER JOIN SALES_MST SM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SALES.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SALES.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SALES.DIVISION_CODE LEFT JOIN DIVISION D ON D.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND D.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SM.CUSTOMER_CODE LEFT JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.TARGET_FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE AND FM.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND FM.FTA_STATUS = '4' WHERE 1=1
AND D.DIVISION_CODE = #{division_code}
AND (C.CUSTOMER_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' OR C.CUSTOMER_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' )
ORDER BY SM.INVOICE_DATE, C.CUSTOMER_CODE, D.DIVISION_CODE
